Most are intentional: a fitting set into a structural shell -- a lamp recess in a hull, a strut landing, a ridge into a cap -- puts shell vertices inside the solid by design, exactly as a bolt in a hole shares volume. Review the ones you did not intend, such as a cloth crossing a wall or a canopy pierced by a mast, and move the surface clear or cut it back to the solid. Vertices are the samples, so a solid thinner than this surface’s facet spacing can pass between two of them.

Most are intentional: a fitting set into a structural shell -- a lamp recess in a hull, a strut landing, a ridge into a cap -- puts shell vertices inside the solid by design, exactly as a bolt in a hole shares volume. Review the ones you did not intend, such as a cloth crossing a wall or a canopy pierced by a mast, and move the surface clear or cut it back to the solid. Vertices are the samples, so a solid thinner than this surface’s facet spacing can pass between two of them.

metrics.partVolumeScope: Visible static closed mesh pairs, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes intra-mesh intersections, motion, open surfaces and usable passage space. Positive overlap may be intentional.
metrics.openSurfaceScope: Visible static open surfaces sampled at their vertices against visible static closed solids, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes open-vs-open pairs, motion, and any solid thinner than the sampled surface's facet spacing. Penetration within the contact tolerance is treated as intended contact, and penetration beyond it may still be intentional, as a fitting socketed into a shell is.

metrics.instanceabilitySummary: D (informational, not a QA verdict), set by 9 distinct materials (D at 7-12). Also: 1 transparent material (lowers only A/B to C); 108 geometries; 223 draw calls. Optional advice, not a requirement: merging smooth-structure:structure-gray + dark-trim + smooth-structure + accent-paint and 2 more (differ in baseColorFactor, metallicFactor, roughnessFactor); emissive-cool + emissive-magenta (differ in baseColorFactor, emissiveFactor, KHR_materials_emissive_strength) would leave 3 materials (B at 2-3; other factors give C).
